schoolPressures.label: Cane migration
schoolPressures.detail: Six months away takes parents, and sometimes older children, from home across two school terms.

schoolPressures.label: Cane-cutting work
schoolPressures.detail: He fears his son, old enough to be a second hand in a koyta pair, will leave before Class 10.

schoolPressures.label: No camp schools
schoolPressures.detail: The High Court ordered tent schools and seasonal hostels near labour camps, but implementation is patchy.

schoolPressures.label: Debt and costs
schoolPressures.detail: The mukadam's advance and the cane price decide whether school fees and uniforms can be met.

pressures: Six months away at the cane harvest takes the parents, and sometimes older children, from home across two school terms, so his children are in and out of class.
His son is old enough to be a second hand in a koyta pair, so he may leave before Class 10 when the season calls.
The High Court ordered tent schools and seasonal hostels near labour camps, but they are patchy, so his children often have no class to attend at the camp.
The mukadam's advance and the cane price decide whether fees and uniforms can be paid, so one bad payment can end a child's year.
factorEffects.sanitation: If the family's camp or village home lacks a proper toilet, his daughter's attendance would suffer first.
factorEffects.district: The factor flags the share of English-medium schools in Belagavi. The card shows cane migration, his son's farm-work future, missing camp schools and debt as the pressures, not language.

changes.effect: When his children are in school between cane seasons, repaired classrooms would keep their lessons running; broken rooms make catching up after migration harder.

changes.factor: % Schools with Furniture available for students
changes.effect: Desks and benches matter for children who return mid-year from the cane fields; a school without them feels less worth coming back to.
Where more mothers have ten years of schooling, children tend to stay in school longer; that could help his daughter stay on despite the pull of cane work.

lag.effect: Chikkodi has one of the lowest shares of women teachers in Karnataka; for his daughter, fewer women teachers can make high school feel less safe.

schoolPressures.label: Distance to school
schoolPressures.detail: Only primary schools are nearby; Class 9 means daily travel to a town high school.

schoolPressures.label: Care work
schoolPressures.detail: With her mother in the fields and father away, her daughter is relied on for cooking and sibling care.

schoolPressures.label: Fluoride in water
schoolPressures.detail: Elevated fluoride in Indi taluk borewells is linked to joint pain and deformities that can reduce school attendance.

schoolPressures.label: Early marriage
schoolPressures.detail: Early marriage is a live risk at the Class 8-10 age, especially if the household hits a financial crisis.

pressures: Only primary schools are nearby, so Class 9 means daily travel to a town high school, and the journey decides whether her daughter goes on.
With her mother in the fields and her father away, her daughter handles cooking and sibling care, so school competes with the home.
Elevated fluoride in Indi's borewell water is linked to joint pain and deformities that can reduce attendance, a health cost that adds to the others.
At 13 to 15 an early marriage is a live risk, especially if the household hits a financial crisis, and it ends schooling at once.
factorEffects.sanitation: If her tanda household lacks a proper toilet, her teenage daughter, already relied on for cooking and care, would be the first to miss school.
factorEffects.district: The factor flags the share of English-medium schools in Vijayapura. The card shows distance, care work, fluoride-linked illness and early marriage as the pressures, not language.

changes.effect: Vijayapura's schools are close to full toilet coverage but among the lowest in the state; a working girls' toilet matters for her teenage daughter.
Repaired classrooms would make the long trip to school more worth it for her children, when distance is already a reason to stay home.
A playground and sport give her younger son a reason to keep coming to school while care work and distance pull the other way.

lag.effect: Vijayapura has one of the lowest shares of women teachers in Karnataka; with the pressure of early marriage, her daughter may have few women to turn to at school.
